summary: Starry Sea Acquisition Corp (SSEA), a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting entry into a merger agreement on August 22, 2026. SSEA will merge into its wholly-owned subsidiary Purchaser, which will concurrently acquire 100% of SuperiorMed via a merger of Merger Sub into SuperiorMed. Consideration is stock: Purchaser Class A shares (1 vote each) and Class B shares (10 votes each), issued to SSEA and SuperiorMed shareholders. The SPAC merger and acquisition merge concurrently. No price/share, premium, or advisors stated. Watch for shareholder approval and closing conditions.
